create_w2vbert_config: create a W2VBertConfig with default 600m architecture settings for a w2v-BERT model
validate_w2vbert_config: validate a W2VBertConfig to check layer_drop_p, encoder layers, and codebook constraints
register_w2vbert_configs: register the 300m and 600m w2v-BERT architecture presets into a DependencyContainer
customize_w2vbert_encoder: customize the nested Wav2Vec2EncoderConfig to change model_dim, attention heads, or ffn_inner_dim
configure_w2vbert_masking: configure temporal and spatial masking parameters like span_len and max_prob in the w2v2_config
